parameters.help_en:
The session ID for logon.

If no virtual MFA device is bound or client secondary authentication is not enabled, you do not need to specify SessionId.
If a virtual MFA device is bound or client secondary authentication is enabled, you must specify SessionId in the logon authentication stages after ADPassword. You can obtain SessionId from the response of the convenience account verification (when the GetLoginToken request is in the ADPassword stage)
parameters.help_zh:
登录的会话ID。

若未绑定虚拟MFA设备或者未开启客户端二次认证，则不需要填写SessionId。
若已绑定虚拟MFA设备或者已开启客户端二次认证，则ADPassword之后的登录认证阶段需要填写SessionId。可从便捷账号验证（即GetLoginToken请求处于ADPassword阶段）的返回结果中获取SessionId
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en:
The current logon authentication stage. Valid values:

ADPassword: verifies user information. Specify this value when password authentication is used for a convenience account or an AD account.
MFABind: binds a virtual MFA device.
MFAVerify: verifies the security code generated by the virtual MFA device.
TokenVerify: performs client secondary authentication.
ChangePassword: changes the user password.
KeepAliveVerify: exchanges a valid KeepAliveToken for a LoginToken.
PhoneVerifyTenantSelect: selects an enterprise ID for logon in the mobile phone number logon scenario.
VerifyForRisk: performs identity verification after a logon risk is identified
parameters.help_zh:
当前登录认证阶段，依次为：

`ADPassword`：验证用户信息。当使用便捷账号或者AD账号的账密认证时填写此值。
`MFABind`：绑定虚拟MFA设备。
`MFAVerify`：验证虚拟MFA设备生成的安全码。
`TokenVerify`：客户端二次认证。
`ChangePassword`：修改用户密码。
`KeepAliveVerify`:  KeepAliveToken有效时，可用于换取LoginToken。
`PhoneVerifyTenantSelect`: 手机号登录场景下，用于选择其中一个企业ID登录。
`VerifyForRisk`: 识别登录风险后的核身校验

parameters.help_en: The token used to keep the user logged on. After a successful logon and if the user enables the keep-logged-on option, the API returns KeepAliveToken. Within the validity period of KeepAliveToken, you can call the GetLoginToken API operation and set CurrentStage to KeepAliveVerify to exchange it for a logon credential (LoginToken). This parameter is required when CurrentStage is set to KeepAliveVerify
parameters.help_zh: 用于保持登录的凭证（Token），在登录成功且用户开启了保持登录选项后，接口会返回KeepAliveToken，在KeepAliveToken有效期内可以调用GetLoginToken接口并将CurrentStage设为KeepAliveVerify来换取登录凭证（LoginToken）。当CurrentStage为KeepAliveVerify时，KeepAliveToken必填

AccessType.description_en: The network connectivity type of the client
AccessType.description_zh: 客户端的网络连接类型

AccountType.description_en: The account type, which can be a convenience account or an AD domain account
AccountType.description_zh: 账号类型， 便捷账号或者AD域账号

Email.description_en:
The email address of the user. It is returned along with the LoginToken after logon.

If the account is a convenience account, the email address specified when the convenience account was created is returned.
If the account is an AD domain account, the email address is returned in the following format: username@AD domain name
Email.description_zh:
用户邮箱。在登录后随LoginToken返回。

如果是便捷账号，返回创建便捷账号时设置的邮箱。
如果是AD域账号，返回以下形式：用户名@AD域名

EndUserId.description_en: The username of the convenience account or the AD username
EndUserId.description_zh: 便捷账号用户名或AD用户名

IdpId.description_en: The configuration ID of the identity source to which the user belongs

Industry.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available
Industry.description_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用

KeepAliveToken.description_en: The token used to keep the user logged on. If the logon is successful and the user enables the keep-alive option, the KeepAliveToken is returned. If the keep-alive option is not enabled, an empty value is returned
KeepAliveToken.description_zh: 用于保持登录的凭证（Token），在登录成功且用户开启了保持登录选项后，接口会返回`KeepAliveToken`。若未开启保持登录选项，则返回空值

Label.description_en: The properties of the convenience account. If the account is an AD domain account, an empty value is returned
Label.description_zh: 便捷账号属性。如果是AD域账号，则返回空值

MfaTypeList.description_en: The available MFA verification types when MFA verification is triggered
MfaTypeList.description_zh: 触发MFA校验时，可选的MFA校验类型

Stage.description_en: The value of the CurrentStage parameter after an MFA type is selected
Stage.description_zh: 选定MFA类型后，对应CurrentStage参数的值

NextStage.description_en:
The expected next stage. For example, if the administrator enables MFA authentication in the Alibaba Cloud Workspace Enterprise Edition console, after the username and password authentication is passed (that is, after the `ADPassword` stage), this parameter returns `MFAVerify`, indicating that MFA authentication is required.

For more information about each authentication stage, see the metric description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter in this operation
NextStage.description_zh:
预期的下一阶段。例如，若管理员在无影云电脑企业版控制台开启了MFA认证，则当用户名密码认证通过后（即`ADPassword`阶段后），该参数会返回`MFAVerify`，表示此时需要做MFA认证。

关于各认证阶段的详细信息，参见本接口请求参数`CurrentStage`的参数说明

OfficeSites.description_en: The office network information corresponding to the AD after AD logon
OfficeSites.description_zh: AD登录后，该AD对应的办公网络信息

items.description_en: The office network ID corresponding to the AD after AD logon
items.description_zh: AD登录后，该AD对应的办公网络ID

Phone.description_en: The mobile phone number of the convenience account. If the account is an AD domain account, an empty value is returned
Phone.description_zh: 便捷账号的手机号。如果是AD域账号，则返回空值

additionalProperties.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available
additionalProperties.description_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用

Props.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available
Props.description_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用

QrCodePng.description_en:
The QR code of the secret key used to attach a virtual MFA device. The QR code uses Base64 encoding. This parameter can be empty and is used in the `MFABind` stage.

For more information about each authentication stage, see the metric description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter in this operation
QrCodePng.description_zh:
绑定虚拟MFA设备时的密钥二维码。使用Base64编码。可以为空，用于`MFABind`阶段。

关于各认证阶段的详细信息，参见本接口请求参数`CurrentStage`的参数说明

RiskVerifyInfo.description_en:
The information related to logon risk identification. If a risk is detected, identity verification is required by using the returned email address or mobile phone number.
Call the SendVerifyCode operation to send a verification code to the returned mobile phone number or email address, and then call the GetLoginToken operation with the CurrentStage parameter set to VerifyForRisk to verify the identity
RiskVerifyInfo.description_zh:
登录风险识别相关信息，如检测到风险，需要通过返回的邮箱或者手机号进行核身。
通过返回的手机号或邮箱，调用`SendVerifyCode`接口发送验证码，然后调用`GetLoginToken`接口指定`CurrentStage`参数为`VerifyForRisk`进行核身

Email.description_en: The email address used for identity verification
Email.description_zh: 用于身份验证的邮箱地址

Locked.description_en: Indicates whether the user is locked

Phone.description_en: The mobile phone number used for identity verification

Secret.description_en:
The secret key used to attach a virtual MFA device. It is used in the `MFABind` stage.

For more information about each authentication stage, see the metric description of the `CurrentStage` request parameter in this operation
Secret.description_zh:
绑定虚拟MFA设备时的密钥。用于`MFABind`阶段。

关于各认证阶段的详细信息，参见本接口请求参数`CurrentStage`的参数说明

SessionId.description_en: The session ID. This parameter is returned only when the GetLoginToken operation is called for the first time in the same session. If multiple authentications are required, this parameter must be passed in subsequent stages
SessionId.description_zh: 会话ID。 仅在同一会话第一次调用GetLoginToken时返回。需要多次认证时，后续的阶段需要传入该参数

TenantAlias.description_en: The name of the enterprise identifier for logon
TenantAlias.description_zh: 登录的企业标识符名称

TenantId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. This parameter is used for hardware terminal identification
TenantId.description_zh: 阿里云账号ID。硬件终端识别使用

TenantInfos.description_en: The enterprise ID information. In the mobile phone number logon scenario, a single mobile phone number may be authorized to log on to multiple enterprise IDs. In this case, you must pass CurrentState:PhoneVerifyTenantSelect to select one of the enterprise IDs for logon
TenantInfos.description_zh: 企业ID信息，在手机号登录场景下，一个手机号可能开通了多个企业ID的登录能力，此时需要传入CurrentState:PhoneVerifyTenantSelect选择其中一个企业ID进行登录

AccessType.description_en: The network connectivity type of the client
AccessType.description_zh: 客户端的网络连接类型

VpcRegionId.description_en: The VPC region ID. This parameter is used for private network logon

WindowDisplayMode.description_en: This parameter is not publicly available
WindowDisplayMode.description_zh: 该参数不对外开放使用

WyId.description_en: The globally unique ID of the user
